current_concerns.primary_problems: Restricting food and counting calories, with frequent preoccupation about body shape. Avoids eating with other people, which causes awkwardness at home and with friends. This has been ongoing since age 18. Over the past year, has been trying to regain some weight but continues to plan the day around food.
current_concerns.goals: Be able to eat a meal with friends without spending days planning it beforehand, and eventually stop planning the entire day around food.
